name: com.streethawk.library.SelftestActivity
description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. StreetHawk opens this Activity when its self-test screen is requested. The screen offers SDK checks and actions for push, location, Bluetooth, feedback, app links, and crash reporting.
disableEffect: StreetHawk's diagnostic screen and its built-in checks will be unavailable.
